politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: You can: Access, add, delete or edit your Memories at all time through your settings.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Durée de conservation des données
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: We store your personal data only as long as needed for the purposes described in Section 3 of this Privacy Policy.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Destinataires des données
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: We may share your personal data on a need-to-know basis with the following parties: Authorized members of our teams who need to access your personal data, strictly to perform their jobs

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Prise de décision automatisée
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Mistral AI does not engage in profiling or automated decision-making in the processing of personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Sécurité des données (art. 32 RGPD)
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Before engaging with any provider which handles customer data, our security team conducts audits to ensure they meet our privacy and security standards, in accordance with our certifications.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Collecte indirecte : catégories concernées
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: **Data publicly available on the Internet.** Our artificial intelligence models are trained on data that is publicly available on the Internet by third parties, which may contain personal data, even if we use good practices to filter out such personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Collecte indirecte : source des données
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: **Data provided by third-parties: Hugging Face.** If you download our artificial intelligence models on Hugging Face, we collect your username and email address to enforce our license and send you communications about our new models.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit d'introduire une plainte (CNIL)
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: You have the right to lodge a complaint before the competent data protection authority, including the French data protection authority (the CNIL).

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit de rectification
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Rectification. You have the right to ask us to update or correct your personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit d'accès
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Access. You have the right to know if we process your personal data. You also have the right to request a copy of such personal data

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit à l'effacement
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Deletion. You have the right to delete and/or ask us to delete your personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit à la limitation du traitement
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Limitation. You have the right to ask us to freeze the processing of your personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit à la portabilité
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Portability. We've introduced a user control which allows you to export your data at all times from your Mistral AI account.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Droit d'opposition
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Objection. You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data.

politique_donnees_personnelles.label: Date de dernière mise à jour de la politique
politique_donnees_personnelles.quote: Effective:July 27, 2026
